posts.text:
Water is the lifeblood of the valley.

I participated in a roundtable discussion with leaders from Gering Ft Laramie and Farmers Irrigation Districts in Scottsbluff last week.  They shared the impact of a very dry year on ag producers and the local community.

I appreciated the updates they provided and will continue to do my part to support our hardworking ag communities.

posts.text:
When I was Governor, we worked to strengthen mental health care in Nebraska.  As a result, U.S. News and World Report ranked Nebraska as having the fourth-best mental health in the nation.

One of the best ways to support mental well-being is by getting outside and getting active. This summer, I encourage all Nebraskans to join Nebraska Game and Parks’ Outdoor Nebraska 250-Mile Challenge.

This is a great way to explore our state and care for your well-being.

The @USGAO estimated from 2018 to 2022, between $233 to $521 billion a year in taxpayer money was lost to fraud, waste, and abuse. One of my top priorities in the Senate is preventing these gross abuses.

I joined several of my colleagues to launch the Anti-Fraud Task Force. This task force will examine fraud, waste, and abuse across federal programs. We need tostrengthen government accountability to ensure the proper stewardship of taxpayer dollars.
posts.summary: Launches task force to combat federal fraud and waste

posts.text:
Nebraskans are honest, trusting people.

We expect others to behave the same way. However, too many fraudsters are stealing taxpayer money.

Our bill will combat this fraud, waste, and abuse. It will protect American taxpayer dollars and ensure our programs serve only Americans who need them.
posts.summary: Proposes bill to combat fraud and protect taxpayer dollars

posts.text:
Preserving our great nation for another 250 years will require us to recommit to protecting Americans, our tax dollars, and our values.

This includes combatting fraudsters that are stealing from Americans and driving up the cost of living.  That’s why I co-founded the Anti-Fraud Task Force.

I’m proud to continue my efforts to fight fraud, waste, and abuse across our country.
